meta.title: SIMUMAV — Real world, real physics drone simulation
meta.desc: SIMUMAV: a browser drone simulation game powered by ArduPilot SITL physics, Google 3D world and a Mission Planner link. Build your hangar, pick your crew, draw your track, fly. Defend ground control with INTERCEPTOR drones, radar and an electro-optical camera.
hero.title: The sky is yours.
hero.sub: Real terrain, real wind, a real flight controller. SIMUMAV pairs ArduPilot physics with the Google 3D world; take off from your browser, fly with Mission Planner.
mod.title: From hangar to operations
mod.sub: Every flight is a story: choose your drone, assign your pilot, set up a track, draw a mission, fly and watch the replay.
mod.hangar.d: Multirotor, fixed wing, helicopter, FPV, interceptor and VTOL. Rotating 3D models, your own parameter tuning.
mod.crew.d: Ten characters, your own pilot name. Flights and hours accumulate on your profile.
mod.tracks.d: Pick any point on Earth: real terrain tiles, satellite texture, wind, time of day and weather.
mod.missions.d: Corridor, free flight, spray slicing, FPV flags and survey. Draw the plan on top of the 3D world.
mod.fly.d: Wheels, ramp, vehicle or hand launch. Full HUD, drone panel and FPV; with video and .bin logs.
mod.ops.d: A card for every flight: track, drone, pilot, result. Click, replay, analyse.
phys.title: Looks like a game, behaves like a simulator
phys.sub: What runs underneath is not a game engine; it is the very code real drones fly on.
phys.sitl.d: A real ArduPilot flight controller runs for every flight. Parameters, modes, failsafes: identical to the field.
phys.g3d.d: Photorealistic 3D tiles and real elevation data. When you fly through a valley, the valley is really there.
phys.mp.d: Connect to your flight over TCP; upload missions, watch telemetry, download the log. The same stream as a real drone.
fpv.title: Put on the goggles, pass the flags
fpv.sub: Analog FPV video effect, flag courses and a ready 250 mm racing drone: your first flight is waiting the minute you sign up.
fpv.p1: Low-latency camera view with optional analog noise.
fpv.p2: FPV-1 and the TRTEST track come with every account.
cta.title: Take your place on the runway
cta.sub: Free account, first flight within minutes. Already have a Mastertool account? Sign straight in.

legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.p1: SIMUMAV authenticates through the Master Tool account service (mastertool.download). Your password never leaves your browser in plain text; only a derived hash is sent to the server.
legal.privacy.p2: Data we store: your email, display name, language and theme preferences and your game content (hangar, crew, tracks, missions and flight records). Flight records are visible only to you and kept on the server within a per-user quota.
legal.privacy.p3: Cookies: a session cookie (HttpOnly, Secure), your language/theme preference and — only with your consent — Google Analytics cookies (see below). We use no advertising cookies. Maps and 3D tiles are loaded from Google and Cesium services, whose own privacy policies apply.
legal.privacy.p4: You can delete your account from mastertool.download › My account; your game data is deleted with it. Questions: destek@mastertool.download
legal.kvkk.title: Data Protection Notice (KVKK)
legal.kvkk.p1: Under Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 the data controller is Master Tool. Personal data (email, name, IP address, session records) is processed to provide the service, secure your account and meet legal obligations.
legal.kvkk.p2: Data may be stored on servers in Turkey and abroad (cloud infrastructure providers); it is shared with third parties only where legally required and never for marketing.
legal.kvkk.p3: Under Article 11 you may access your data, request correction or deletion and object to processing. Requests go to destek@mastertool.download and are answered within 30 days.
legal.kvkk.p4: Session and audit records (sign-in, flight start, quota overrun) are kept for 90 days for security purposes.
legal.terms.title: Terms of Use
legal.terms.p1: SIMUMAV is a simulation game; it does not replace real flight training or certification. Parameters from the game must be verified against the manufacturer's documentation before being applied to real drones.
legal.terms.p2: Your account is personal and may not be shared. One concurrent flight per user, 45 minutes per flight and storage quotas apply. Accounts that abuse the service (automated requests, vulnerability probing, attempts to connect to someone else's flight) are suspended.
legal.terms.p3: The Mission Planner link is limited to your own flight and to the first connecting IP. Third-party services (Google, Cesium, ArduPilot) are subject to their own licences and terms.
legal.terms.p4: The service is provided "as is"; no liability is accepted for outages, data loss or indirect damages. The terms may change with prior notice.
legal.terms.p5: Disputes are governed by the laws of the Republic of Türkiye and the courts of Ankara.
cookie.title: Cookies
cookie.text: To improve the site we collect anonymous usage statistics with Google Analytics and measure ad conversions with Google Ads (IP anonymised). Loaded only with your consent; you can change your choice at any time.
cookie.necessary: Essential cookies (session, language, theme) — always on
cookie.analytics: Analytics and ad-conversion cookies (Google Analytics, Google Ads)
legal.privacy.p5: Only with your consent we collect anonymous usage statistics with Google Analytics 4 (Google Ireland Ltd.): page views, language, device type and in-game events (flight start/end, sign-up, sign-in). Your IP address is anonymised, advertising signals and personalisation are disabled and no email or name is sent. Consent is enforced with Consent Mode v2; if you decline, no Google script is loaded at all. You can update your choice via the "Change cookie preferences" link at the bottom of this page. Google's privacy policy: policies.google.com/privacy
reel.label: Fleet showreel
hangar.title: Meet your fleet
hangar.sub: Every drone in the system as a true-to-scale 3D model: CAYMAZ, INTERCEPTOR interceptors, multicopters, VTOL and fixed wings. Each one joins your hangar in a single tap.
hangar.hint: Click a model to enlarge it, drag to rotate.
fleet.caymaz.d: From the STEP model of the delta-wing UAV we build: 3.03 m span, pusher propeller, two elevons.
fleet.icept_x4.d: Cigar fuselage, X wing, four tractor props. Takes off vertically on its tail and reaches ~400 km/h in level flight.
fleet.sting.d: Compact interceptor (~0.45 m), four props; vertical take-off, high-speed level flight.
fleet.p1sun.d: Interceptor with a nose camera (~0.44 m), four props; fast climbs and dives.
fleet.typhoon_h480.d: Six-rotor scout with a gimbal camera; steady hover in the wind.
fleet.standard_vtol.d: X8 wing + four lift rotors + pusher: no runway needed, cruises like a plane.
fleet.believer.d: Twin-motor mapping aircraft (1.9 m), conventional tail; long range.
fleet.zephyr.d: Delta flying wing (1.5 m); high-speed tuning, elevon control.
fleet.x500.d: Carbon-frame quad (0.6 m); development and mission platform.
fleet.heli.d: Single main rotor + tail rotor (1.75 m); collective and cyclic control.
fleet.iris_fpv.d: Iris with an FPV camera; acro rate loops, ready for gate tracks.
fleet.rc_cessna.d: RC Cessna 172 (1.1 m); classic flying with aileron, elevator and rudder.
fleet.iris.d: 3DR Iris quadrotor (0.5 m); ideal for your first flight.
fleet.talon_vtail.d: Talon-style V-tail aircraft (1.72 m), single pusher prop, ruddervators.
fleet.jet.d: High-speed jet: up to 170 m/s, hard manoeuvres.
crew.title: The pilot seat is yours
crew.sub: Pick your pilot from ten characters and name them. Every flight's time, count and result is written into your pilot's career.
crew.p1: Ten characters, your own pilot name and a default pilot.
crew.p2: Flight count and hours build up on the profile.
crew.p3: Rank and score in mission reports.
tracks.title: Anywhere on Earth is a runway
tracks.sub: Pick a point on the map; real terrain tiles, satellite imagery, wind, time of day and weather are saved with your track.
tracks.p1: Google 3D tiles or procedural terrain: valley, runway, trees and buildings.
tracks.p2: Wind and gusts; day, dusk, night; clear, cloudy, rain, fog, snow.
tracks.p3: FPV gates and a ground control site on the same track.
tracks.alt: SIMUMAV Tracks screen: saved track cards
missions.title: Draw the mission, then fly it
missions.sub: Corridor, free flight, spray swaths, FPV gates, survey and “Defend ground control”. The route is drawn on top of the 3D world.
missions.p1: Drag waypoints across 3D terrain; altitude and speed per point.
missions.p2: Defence mission: seed, wave count, difficulty and interceptor rack.
missions.p3: The mission uploads to Mission Planner in the same format.
fly.title: Contact. Arm. Take-off.
fly.sub: The Fly wizard sets up drone, track, power, mission, targets and launcher step by step; a real ArduPilot SITL is ready for take-off in seconds.
fly.p1: Wheels, ramp, vehicle, hand launch or INTERCEPTOR launchers.
fly.p2: Operations panel, flight display, FPV OSD and military HUD.
fly.p3: Fly with the virtual sticks, a gamepad or Mission Planner.
ops.title: Every flight is a record
ops.sub: Your flights, card by card, in Operations: track, drone, pilot and result. Click to replay in 3D and dig into telemetry and the mission report.
ops.p2: Mission report: intercepted and leaked threats, hit rate, score.
ops.p3: Download .bin logs and analyse them in Mission Planner.
sys.title: Defend ground control
sys.sub: Radar catches the threat, the electro-optical camera locks on, the INTERCEPTOR launches. Every frame below is from the real app.
sys.defend.c: “Defend ground control” mission: mission strip, radar and EO screens, station health and the interceptor rack.
sys.radar.d: Up to 20 km coverage, scan sweep and target tracks. Click a target and the EO camera slews to it.
sys.eo.d: Gimbal EO camera: day, thermal and night vision; auto-tracking and zoom.
sys.tgt.d: F-16 style TD box, prisms and lock cues; arrow and angle to off-screen targets.
sys.thermal.d: Heat signatures glow even in the dark; palette and zoom are selectable.
sys.launch.d: Four/eight-cell pods, tube and handheld launcher; aim through the SCOPE window and fire.
sys.report.d: Intercepted and leaked threats, station health, hit rate, timeline and score.
sys.alt.defend: Flight screen: Defend ground control mission with radar and EO windows
sys.alt.radar: Radar screen: range rings and a target track
sys.alt.tgt: F-16 style target symbology on the gimbal camera
sys.alt.tgtthermal: Target symbology on the thermal camera
sys.alt.launch: INTERCEPTOR launcher choice in the Fly wizard: four- and eight-cell boxes, single tube, handheld launcher and 3D preview
fleet.rover_4x4.d: Ackermann-steered 4×4 scout with an EO/IR + LIDAR mast; up to 72 km/h on ArduRover.
fleet.rover_ugv.d: Tracked unmanned ground vehicle: turns on the spot (skid steering), sensor turret.
fleet.rover_bot.d: Six-wheeled sidewalk delivery robot (0.78 m), skid steering, flag mast.
top10.title: TOP 10 PILOTS
top10.formula: Score = match points (ring ×100, finish +250, place bonus; dogfight win 1000) + win +300 + ring pace (≤200) + flight discipline (avg score ×1.5 × up to 20 flights) + target intercepts (best 10 flights ×0.5). Matches played only against AI count half.
top10.privacy: Names and e-mails are masked. To leave the list: Settings → “Hide me from the leaderboard”.
top10.empty: No ranked pilots yet — win the first match!
top10.error: Could not load the list; try again shortly.
top10.sub: The ten best pilots by match wins, ring-race pace, flight discipline and target intercepts — with their 3D avatars.
top10.demo_tip: Sample entry — replaced by real pilots as scores come in
